environment: Local production build (`next start`) with VERCEL=1 and a local HTTP snapshot endpoint standing in for shared durable storage. Third-party provider hosts are unreachable from this sandbox, so provider fetches fail; that isolates the storage behaviour under test.

cronWithUnreachableProviders.note: 503 here is the honest source-failure path (matchesFetched: 0, previous data retained), not a storage failure.

crossProcessWrite.actor: separate tsx process (hydrate -> add marker match -> persist -> flushDurableStore force)

coldStartAfterLocalCacheCleared.meaning: the restarted instance served data written by another process, read from shared storage only

health.storageKindAgreement: lib/storage selection and the durable layer both report the HTTP backend (kind: http)
